name: Word-highlight caption anchored to the subject

source.description: An inspected product film (batch 1, 2026-11-26) plays a narrated sample explainer whose two-line captions sit directly under the illustration and colour the word being spoken; the recogniser heard the same words as the caption.

technique: Captions show a short phrase (one or two lines) and colour the word being spoken. Placed directly under the thing being explained rather than in a fixed lower third, they keep the eye on the subject while reading.
purpose: Accessibility and sound-off viewing without pulling the eye away from the illustration; emphasis follows the voice.
visual_behaviour: Two centred lines in small sans under the illustration card; one word at a time switches to an accent colour (and back) as it is spoken; the lines change at phrase ends.
mechanics: Word-timed cues (studio.py captions --timing words) grouped into phrases of 3-7 words; highlight the current word (colour or weight) at its measured start; lane = below the subject's box (Studio.boxAt(subject).bottom + gap) instead of the frame's lower third, clamped inside the safe area; phrase swap on a 0.1-0.15 s fade.

decomposition.timing: Highlight per word at its spoken start; phrases 1-3 s.

parameters.name: lane
parameters.description: lower, mid, upper (caption presets) or under-subject (anchored to a box)

parameters.name: highlight
parameters.description: Colour or weight change for the spoken word

use_cases: narrated explainers with one main illustration per scene
failure_modes: Subject-anchored captions that jump with every scene's layout; keep the lane stable inside a scene
Highlight lagging the voice by more than about 100 ms reads as broken; use measured word times
Captions covering the part of the illustration being named

implementation.approach: Studio.comp.captions(parent, cues).schedule(tl) highlights the spoken word from word-timed cues and places each cue in a preset lane (docs/caption-design.md). Since runtime 1.17.0 lane 'subject' sits the caption beside cue.anchor (storyboard caption_lane subject + caption_anchor, optional caption_side above), measured as the anchor renders at the cue's start and held for the cue, clamped to the safe area; no findable anchor falls back to lower.

evidence.notes: Contact sheet inspected: a cue below the pump (5.8-6.5 s), a cue above the valve at its moved position (7.9-8.4 s), then back to the lower lane (9.2 s).

provenance.observed: Inside the product demo, a narrated plant explainer shows two caption lines directly under the illustration; the word being spoken is coloured (red, then blue). Desktop dictation recognised the same words as the caption between 16.7 and 21.2 s.

In the read-aloud step a sentence darkens word by word as the app reads it, on the phone and in the left column (30.5-35.2 s). Note: Variant: an in-app reading highlight shown as a demo, not the film's own caption.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from a user-supplied reference (inspiration-only, rights unknown). No caption text is copied.
